title: Ravana comes to Seetha
introduction: In this chapter Hanuma sees Ravana entering Ashoka garden with a retinue of his wives following him.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टादशः सर्गः
Thus completes 18th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तथा विप्रेक्षमाणस्य वनम् पुष्पितपादपम् |
विचिन्वतश्च वैदेहीम् किंचिच्चेषा निशाभवत्
verses.iast:
tathā viprekśamāṇasya vanam puṣpitapādapam |
vicinvataśca vaidehīm kiñcicceṣā niśābhavat
verses.translation: A little of the night was left while Hanuma was searching like that for Seetha in the garden with flowers in blossom.

verses.devanagari:
षडङ्गवेदविदुषाम् क्रतुप्रवरयाजिनाम् |
शुश्राव ब्रह्मघोषान् स विरात्रे ब्रह्मरक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
ṣaḍaṇ^gavedaviduṣām kratupravarayājinām |
śuśrāva brahmaghoṣān sa virātre brahmarakśasām
verses.translation: That Hanuma heard Vedic sounds early in the morning of Brahma Rakshasas well versed in six parts of Vedas and those who performed excellent sacrifices.

glosses.meaning: well versed in six parts of Vedas

verses.devanagari:
अथ मङ्गलवादित्रशब्दैः श्रुतिमनोहरैः |
प्रबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः
verses.iast:
atha maṇ^galavāditraśabdaiḥ śrutimanoharaiḥ |
prabudhyata mahābāhurdaśagrīvo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Ravana with great arms and great prowess was woken by the sounds of various auspicious musical instruments pleasing to the ear.

glosses.meaning: by the sounds of various auspicious musical instruments

verses.devanagari:
विबुध्य तु यथाकालम् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् |
स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरो वैदेहीमन्वचिन्तयात्
verses.iast:
vibudhya tu yathākālam rākśasendraḥ pratāpavān |
srastamālyāmbaradharo vaidehīmanvacintayāt
verses.translation: The king of rakshasas with great might woke up at the appropriate hour wearing slippery flower garlands remembered about Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
भृशं नियुक्तस्तस्याम् च मदनेन मदोत्कटः |
न स तं राक्षसः कामं शशाकात्मनि गूहितुम्
verses.iast:
bhṛśaṃ niyuktastasyām ca madanena madotkaṭaḥ |
na sa taṃ rākśasaḥ kāmaṃ śaśākātmani gūhitum
verses.translation: In that Seetha's matter, directed a lot by the god of love and excited by passion, that Rakshasa was not capable to suppress in self that desire.

verses.devanagari:
स सर्वाभरणैर्युक्तो बिभच्छ्रियमनुत्तमाम् |
तां नगैर्बहुभिर्जुष्टाम् सर्वपुष्पफलोपगैः
verses.iast:
sa sarvābharaṇairyukto bibhacchriyamanuttamām |
tāṃ nagairbahubhirjuṣṭām sarvapuṣpaphalopagaiḥ
verses.translation: Together with all ornaments wearing great glory that Ravana entered that Ashoka garden having a lot of trees with all fruits and flowers.

verses.devanagari:
वृतां पुष्करिणीभिश्च नानापुष्पोपशोभिताम् |
सदामदैश्च विहगैर्विचित्राम् परमाद्भुताम्
verses.iast:
vṛtāṃ puṣkariṇībhiśca nānāpuṣpopaśobhitām |
sadāmadaiśca vihagairvicitrām paramādbhutām
verses.translation: Ravana entered that great wonderful Ashoka garden together with lakes, shone by various flowers, brilliant with birds always in rut.

verses.devanagari:
ईहामृगैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टां डृष्टिमनोहरैः |
वीथीः संप्रेक्षमाणश्च मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः
नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम् |
अशोकवनकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम्
verses.iast:
īhāmṛgaiśca vividhairjuṣṭāṃ ḍṛṣṭimanoharaiḥ |
vīthīḥ samprekśamāṇaśca maṇikāJṇcanatoraṇāḥ
nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇāṃ phalaiḥ prapatitairvṛtām |
aśokavanakāmeva prāviśatsantatadrumām
verses.translation: Ravana entered Ashoka garden seeing archways of gold and gems crowded by artificial deer of various kinds ravishing eyes and mind, filled with animals of various kinds, together with fallen fruits and full of trees.

glosses.meaning: filled with animals of various kinds

verses.devanagari:
अङ्गनाशतमात्रं तु तं व्रजन्तमनुव्रजत् |
महेन्द्रमिव पौलस्त्यम्ं देवगन्धर्वयोषितः
verses.iast:
aṇ^ganāśatamātraṃ tu taṃ vrajantamanuvrajat |
mahendramiva paulastyamṃ devagandharvayoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: While He was going only a hundred of women followed that Ravana like Deva and Gandharva women following Indra.

verses.devanagari:
दीपिकाः काञ्चनीः काश्चिज्जगृहुस्तत्र योषितः |
वालव्यजनहस्ताश्च तालवृन्तानि चापराः
verses.iast:
dīpikāḥ kāJṇcanīḥ kāścijjagṛhustatra yoṣitaḥ |
vālavyajanahastāśca tālavṛntāni cāparāḥ
verses.translation: There some women bore lamps of gold; some others carried chowries; some others had fans of Palmyra leaves in their hands.

glosses.meaning: (carried) chowries vaalavyajana hastaashcha = (some others had) fans of Palmyra leaves in their hands.

verses.devanagari:
काञ्चनैरपि भृङ्गारैर्जह्रुः सलिलमग्रतः |
मण्डलागान् ब्रुसींश्चापि गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः
verses.iast:
kāJṇcanairapi bhṛṇ^gārairjahruḥ salilamagrataḥ |
maṇḍalāgān brusīṃścāpi gṛhyānyāḥ pṛṣṭhato yayuḥ
verses.translation: Some women carried water in small vessels of gold; some others followed in the back taking pillows with circular ends.

verses.devanagari:
काचिद्रत्नमयीं स्थालीं पूर्णां पानस्य ब्राजतम् |
दक्षिणा दक्षिणेनैव तदा जग्राह पाणिना
verses.iast:
kācidratnamayīṃ sthālīṃ pūrṇāṃ pānasya brājatam |
dakśiṇā dakśiṇenaiva tadā jagrāha pāṇinā
verses.translation: One woman to the right of Ravana held with her right hand a vessel with gem stones filled with liqour.

verses.devanagari:
राजहंसप्रतीकाशं चत्रं पूर्णशशिप्रभम् |
सौवर्णदण्डमपरा गृहीत्वा पृष्ठतो ययौ
verses.iast:
rājahaṃsapratīkāśaṃ catraṃ pūrṇaśaśiprabham |
sauvarṇadaṇḍamaparā gṛhītvā pṛṣṭhato yayau
verses.translation: Another woman went at back taking an umbrella equalling a royal swan with the radiance of full moon with a golden handle.

glosses.meaning: with the radiance of full moon

verses.devanagari:
निद्रामदपरीताक्ष्यो रावनस्योत्तमाः स्त्रियः |
अनुजग्मुः पतिं वीरम् घनम् विद्युल्लता इव
verses.iast:
nidrāmadaparītākṣyo rāvanasyottamāḥ striyaḥ |
anujagmuḥ patiṃ vīram ghanam vidyullatā iva
verses.translation: With sleepy eyes best women of Ravana followed mighty husband like lightning following a cloud.

verses.devanagari:
व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः |
समागळितकेशान्ताः सस्वेदवदनास्तथा
घोर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः |
स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमाः सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः
प्रयान्तं नैरृतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः |
बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः
verses.iast:
vyāviddhahārakeyūrāḥ samāmṛditavarṇakāḥ |
samāgaLitakeśāntāḥ sasvedavadanāstathā
ghorṇantyo madaśeṣeṇa nidrayā ca śubhānanāḥ |
svedakliṣṭāṇ^gakusumāḥ sumālyākulamūrdhajāḥ
prayāntaṃ nairṛtapatiṃ nāryo madiralocanāḥ |
bahumānācca kāmācca priyā bhāryāstamanvayuḥ
verses.translation: With displaced necklaces and armlets, with effaced cover of sandal-paste, with dishevelled hair, and also with sweaty faces, staggering due to surviving trace of liquor and due to sleepiness, with shrivelled flowers on perspiring bodies, with dishevelled hair along with good garlands, with intoxicating eyes, women who were dear wives followed that king of Rakshasas who was going due to respect and due to love.

glosses.meaning: due to surviving trace of liqour and due to sleepiness
with shrivelled flowers on perspiring bodies
with dishevelled hair along with good garlands

verses.devanagari:
स च कामपराधीनः पतिस्तासां महाबलः |
सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ
verses.iast:
sa ca kāmaparādhīnaḥ patistāsāṃ mahābalaḥ |
sītāsaktamanā mando mandāJṇcitagatirbabhau
verses.translation: Husband of those women, of great might, who was surrendered to lust, that Ravana also who was dull witted, with his mind interested in Seetha shone with a slow and beautiful gait.

glosses.meaning: with his mind interested in Seetha
with a slow and beautiful gait.

verses.devanagari:
ततः काञ्चीनिनादं च नूपुराणाम् च निस्वनम् |
शुश्राव परमस्त्रीणां स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kāJṇcīninādaṃ ca nūpurāṇām ca nisvanam |
śuśrāva paramastrīṇāṃ sa kapirmārutātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter that Hanuma, the son of wind-god heard the sound of waist-bands and the sound of anklets of those excellent women.

verses.devanagari:
तं चाप्रतिमकर्माणमचिन्त्यबलपौरुषम् |
द्वारदेशमनुप्राप्तं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः
verses.iast:
taṃ cāpratimakarmāṇamacintyabalapauruṣam |
dvāradeśamanuprāptaṃ dadarśa hanumān kapiḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma the monkey saw that Ravana also, performer of deeds without an equal, with unfathomable might and virility, reaching the entrance region.

glosses.meaning: performer of deeds without an equal

verses.devanagari:
दीपिकाभिरनेकाभिः समन्तादवभासितम् |
गन्धतैलावसिक्ताभिर्द्रियमाणाभिरग्रतः
verses.iast:
dīpikābhiranekābhiḥ samantādavabhāsitam |
gandhatailāvasiktābhirdriyamāṇābhiragrataḥ
verses.translation: Wettened by fragrant oil, being carried in front of Ravana, Hanuma saw Ravana being shone in all directions by many lamps.

verses.devanagari:
कामदर्पमदैर्युक्तं जिह्मताम्रायतेक्षणम् |
समक्षमिव कन्दर्पमपविद्धशरासनम्
verses.iast:
kāmadarpamadairyuktaṃ jihmatāmrāyatekśaṇam |
samakśamiva kandarpamapaviddhaśarāsanam
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Ravana together with lust, vanity and intoxication, with wide red eyes which were slanted, like the god of love in person with bow kept at a distance.

glosses.meaning: with wide red eyes which were slanted
with bow kept at a distance

verses.devanagari:
मथितामृतफेनाभमरजोवस्त्रमुत्तमम् |
सलीलमनुकर्षन्तं विमुक्तं सक्तमङ्गदे
verses.iast:
mathitāmṛtaphenābhamarajovastramuttamam |
salīlamanukarṣantaṃ vimuktaṃ saktamaṇ^gade
verses.translation: Hanuma saw Ravana playfully readjusting his excellent upper garment with the luster of churned nectar froth, without stain,slipping being entangled in armlet.

glosses.meaning: With the lustre of churned nectar froth

verses.devanagari:
तं पत्रविटपे लीनः अत्रपुष्पघनावृतह् |
समीपमिव संक्रान्तं निध्यातुमुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
taṃ patraviṭape līnaḥ atrapuṣpaghanāvṛtah |
samīpamiva saṅkrāntaṃ nidhyātumupacakrame
verses.translation: Hanuma blended in a branch full of leaves covered by groups of leaves and flowers started to see that Ravana as though coming near Him.

glosses.meaning: in a branch full of leaves
covered by groups of leaves and flowers

verses.devanagari:
अवेक्षमाणस्तु ततो ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः |
रूपयौवनसंपन्ना रावणस्य वरस्तियः
verses.iast:
avekśamāṇastu tato dadarśa kapikuJṇjaraḥ |
rūpayauvanasampannā rāvaṇasya varastiyaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Hanuma, the best among Vanaras looking in all directions saw best women of Ravana full of beauty and youth.

verses.devanagari:
ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः |
तस्मृगद्विजसम्घष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम्
verses.iast:
tābhiḥ parivṛto rājā surūpābhirmahāyaśāḥ |
tasmṛgadvijasamghaṣṭaṃ praviṣṭaḥ pramadāvanam
verses.translation: King of great fame, Ravana, together with those women with good appearance entered that garden resounded by animals and birds.

verses.devanagari:
क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः |
तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः
वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रामाः |
तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः
verses.iast:
kṣībo vicitrābharaṇaḥ śaṇ^kukarṇo mahābalaḥ |
tena viśravasaḥ putraḥ sa dṛṣṭo rākṣasādhipaḥ
vṛtaḥ paramanārībhistārābhiriva candrāmāḥ |
taṃ dadarśa mahātejāstejovantaṃ mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: That king of Rakshasas who was intoxicated with wonderful ornaments, with pointed ears, son of Visravasa was like the moon together with stars, together with best women was seen by Hanuma. That great Vanara with great brilliance saw that Ravana with glory.

verses.devanagari:
रावणोऽयम् महाबाहुरिति संचिन्त्य वानरः |
अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः
verses.iast:
rāvaṇo'yam mahābāhuriti sañcintya vānaraḥ |
avapluto mahātejā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The son of god of wind Vanara Hanuma of great brilliance thinking thus "This long armed one is Ravana", jumped down.

glosses.meaning: The son of god of wind

verses.devanagari:
स तथाप्युग्रतेजाः सन्निर्धूतस्तस्य तेजसा |
पत्रगुह्यान्तरे सक्तो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
sa tathāpyugratejāḥ sannirdhūtastasya tejasā |
patraguhyāntare sakto hanumān saṃvṛto'bhavat
verses.translation: Thus Hanuma although of terrible energy was overshadowed by Ravana's brilliance and became rooted behind a group of leaves and was concealed.

glosses.meaning: rooted behind a group of leaves

verses.devanagari:
स तामसितकेशान्तां सुश्रोणीं संहतस्तनीम् |
दिदृक्षुरसितापाङ्गमुपावर्तत रावणः
verses.iast:
sa tāmasitakeśāntāṃ suśroṇīṃ saṃhatastanīm |
didṛkśurasitāpāṇ^gamupāvartata rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: That Ravana neared Seetha with black hair, with charming limbs with well knit breasts, with black corners of eyes, wishing to see Her.
